verdict.rationale: Honcho's docs claim developers can "shape retrieval with search, token budgets, summaries, and peer scoping," and its README lists search results as a queryable output. That gives some first-party control beyond a single fixed similarity call, with peer scoping acting as a coarse scope filter. Nothing in the pack describes arbitrary metadata filters, keyword or hybrid search modes, or reranking. missing for 10: documented metadata filter syntax, keyword/hybrid search mode options, reranking support, API-level detail on search parameters, independent or hands-on corroboration.
